answer: The ARGO Framework's 'Advisory and Tooling Layer' provides centralized group-level teams with resources such as RAI toolkits (e.g., fairness metrics libraries, explainability dashboards), training programs and playbooks, technical assets integrated into core development platforms, lightweight reporting mechanisms to improve visibility across units, centralization of common AI assets with applied RAI practices, validation of guidelines through application to group-level AI assets, standardized templates and documentation guidelines for consistent implementation, and feedback channels for business units to report on the effectiveness of group-level assets for their specific use cases.
